description: Edinburgh Airport Safeguarding Zones - Scotland is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Edinburgh Airport has several safeguarding zones: a 30km radius for general development that may affect flight paths, a 13km radius for bird strike prevention which includes monitoring areas with water and waste disposal, and a 5km no-fly zone for drones. Coverage: Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. The portal files it under the publisher Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Its tags are Human health and safety, Transport networks, zones. The portal shows 2025-11-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
